description:
Cast Healer of the Glade by paying {G}.
When Healer of the Glade enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Healer of the Glade
When Healer of the Glade dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Healer of the Glade from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
